project_summary: B2B SaaS launch into a saturated note-taking market with a 2-person team and 9-month runway.

failure_risks.risk: The product launch into the saturated note-taking market might be hard given limited engineering resources and a 9-month runway window.

action_map.validation_step: Estimate real engineering throughput against the launch scope.
action_map.minimum_test: Run a 4-week sprint shipping the MVP feature list and measure completion.
action_map.success_metric: 100% of MVP scope shipped in 4 weeks with under 5 bugs.
action_map.failure_threshold: Less than 60% of MVP scope shipped or more than 15 bugs.
action_map.next_action: If pass: launch. If fail: cut scope or extend runway.

failure_risks.risk: Direct competition from incumbents like Notion and Obsidian could be tough for a 2-person team to overcome in the first 12 months of operation.

action_map.validation_step: Quantify the differentiation gap relative to incumbents.
action_map.minimum_test: Survey 50 prospects on willingness to switch from incumbent tools.
action_map.success_metric: 30% of surveyed prospects say they would switch within 6 months.
action_map.next_action: If pass: ship. If fail: niche the positioning to a single underserved vertical.

failure_risks.risk: User acquisition through TikTok ads could be challenging if the algorithm shifts and CPMs rise above $20 in the next quarter, killing payback periods.

action_map.validation_step: Lock in current CPM economics with a 30-day spend test.
action_map.minimum_test: Spend $3,000 on TikTok ads over 30 days and measure CAC and payback.
action_map.success_metric: CAC under $25 and payback under 3 months.
action_map.failure_threshold: CAC above $50 or payback above 9 months.
action_map.next_action: If pass: scale spend. If fail: switch acquisition channel to SEO or partnerships.
